Sync smart-scale weights from Apple Health or Health Connect. Safe to repeat.

Deletions in the phone's health store are not mirrored; delete here instead.

Create (201) or replace (200) today's check-in. The server decides which day "today" is
(the athlete's time zone), so a phone in another time zone cannot pick the wrong day.

404.description: No check-in for this day yet

put.description: Create (201) or replace (200) the check-in of a day (today or up to 7 days late).

post.description:
Send a message to the coach and get its answer.

Single-turn for now: conversation history is not yet stored or sent (see docs/backlog.md).
